eindtekst: File, URL or PostgreSQL: every table in the workspace entered through Connect, and Preview checks it before it commits.

stappen.tekst: Connect is the front door of data.monster. Three ways in: a file from disk, a URL, or a PostgreSQL database.
Open file brings up your system file picker. CSV, Parquet, JSON and JSONL are supported, and the source file is copied into the workspace so it stays self-contained.
The Database tab hooks up PostgreSQL: paste a connection string, browse its tables and ingest the ones you need as DuckDB snapshots.
Paste the postgres:// URL and Connect lists the schemas and tables. Nothing is copied until you select and ingest.
Back to the Remote tab: this ingests straight from a URL, so no manual downloading.
Type or paste the direct link to a CSV, Parquet or JSON file. Here: a small regions CSV served locally.
Load downloads the file into the workspace and hands it straight to Preview for a column and type check.
You land in Preview: name, type, field and row count of the candidate file. Confirming the ingest is the next tour.
